# `scene.parent`: Set parent

Moves an object under a parent so it follows the parent's transform.

- Category: scene
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(depth + siblings + subtree x path length)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: parent to, ctrl p, attach, link

By default the object keeps its world position (its local transform is recomputed). A parent cannot be the object itself or one of its descendants.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keep_world` | `boolean` | `true` | Keep the world position (default) instead of the local transform. |
| `parent` | `string` | required | New parent (name, path or id). |
| `target` | `string` | required | Object to move (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"parent":"crate","target":"post"}
```

Result: `post (o:3) is now crate/post`
